title: Dynamic Al Migration In Situ Constructs Triple-active Al–OH/Oxygen Vacancy/CoIn2 Interfaces for Boosting CO2 Hydrogenation to Methanol
extraction_notes: No SI catalytic-performance plots were available in the provided SI page images. SI Figure S1 is listed as a stability test of Co2In2Al0.8 at 3 MPa, 280 °C and 18000 mL·gcat−1·h−1, but its plotted image was not provided here, so no first/last stability points could be digitised. SI Figure S4 panels are XRD/O 1s characterization, not catalytic-performance plots. Table S4 on SI page 12 contains printed performance values and was skipped as instructed because tables/text are handled by another pass.
